theorem: There exists a nonempty OPEN neighborhood U of theta0=(1/4,1/4,1/4,1/4) in C^4 such that, for EVERY theta=(v0,v1,v2,lambda) in U, the specified 4x4 local compression of the explicit 4x5 PPT/SN3 grid state is PPT, entangled, and has Schmidt number exactly 2. The associated kernel lines (-v0,-v1,-v2,1,-lambda) fill a full complex-four-dimensional open neighborhood in the local projective chart, and may be chosen with all five coordinates nonzero. No numerical radius is claimed.
physical_map: K_theta|0,1,2>=|0,1,2>, K_theta|3>=v0|0>+v1|1>+v2|2>+lambda|3>, K_theta|4>=|3>. It always has rank4. rho_theta is the normalization of (I tensor K_theta)R(I tensor K_theta)^*, where R is the explicit 4x5 positive operator in frontier-20261028-grid-state-five-projections-v1.json SHA256 9863760e2ca2331164d12e62300f3ad7db5b6a17a3ef424e360d504d541004a9. R and R^Gamma have explicit exact PSD certificates there, so rho_theta is PPT for every theta.

rank2_chart: For each of the 753 nonbasis atoms fix its own Gaussian-rational alpha,beta,b,f, with alpha*f!=0, as in the chart-parameter file. For variable theta near theta0 with lambda!=0 define d=v1*f-alpha*b-beta, c=(1+v2*f-beta*b)/alpha, e=alpha+beta*d-v0*f, h=lambda*f/alpha, gamma=(lambda*e+c)/h, delta=v1*e-gamma*b, i=gamma*c+delta*b-v2*e, g=gamma+delta*d-v0*e, and xi(theta)=(1,b,c,d,e,f,g,i,h). Then the projected source range matrix has rows r2=alpha*r0+beta*r1 and r3=gamma*r0+delta*r1, so its complex Schmidt rank is <=2 for every such theta. Multiply xi(theta) by the positive integer scalar that turns its base value into the corresponding certified integer vector z_j. The other eight atoms are the fixed non-A source generators, each of Schmidt rank <=2 before any local map. Every atom varies continuously on lambda!=0.
continuity_proof: Let A(theta) be the real 81x761 matrix of Hermitian Gram-coordinate columns of the above coefficient vectors, and let d=diag(1,1,3,1,3,3,3,3,3) encoded as 81 real coordinates. At theta0 the exact certificate supplies A(theta0)w0=d with all 761 entries of w0 strictly positive. The modular certificate shows an 81x81 submatrix A_B(theta0) has nonzero rational determinant. Hold the 680 nonbasis weights fixed at their positive base values, and define w_B(theta)=A_B(theta)^(-1)(d-A_nonB(theta)w_nonB). Entries of A are continuous real functions of theta and its conjugate; the determinant stays nonzero near theta0, and w_B(theta) remains strictly positive by continuity. Thus A(theta)w(theta)=d with all weights positive on a nonempty open neighborhood. Mapping the coefficient Gram identity through the SAME K_theta yields an actual finite positive sum of complex SR<=2 projectors for R_theta, not merely a formal moment profile.
entanglement_open_condition: The local 3x3 core depends on v=(v0,v1,v2) but not lambda and is T_v=[A]+[B]+[D]+3([02]+[20]+[|2> tensor v]). Near theta0, v1!=0 and its range has unique coordinates [[a,b,c],[d,a,b],[e+v0*f,-d+v1*f,a+v2*f]]. For a rank-one vector, minors imply 2a^2=-(a*v2-b*v1)f. Any separable decomposition would therefore give 2<=sqrt(3(|v1|^2+|v2|^2)), since the actual moments are sum|a|^2=sum|b|^2=1, sum a*conjugate(b)=0, sum|f|^2=3. At theta0 the square of the right side is 3/8<4. Restricting the above open neighborhood to the strict inequality 3(|v1|^2+|v2|^2)<4 proves every corresponding rho_theta is entangled. Hence every such state has SN exactly2.
